one_line: Lemma 1 (Gram capacity pc >= a^2, j >= d^2/(a+c)) and Theorem 2 (support inequality on the high-j large-pc plus region of T_65). Both chart certificates replayed EXACT with identical term counts. Lemma 1 is CITED to so4-atoms-part2b G4, where it is proved.

statements.label: Lemma 1
statements.restatement: For the T_65 face cost c = q f2 + p f9 + j f1 + c f45 + e f5 + d f35 + b f0 + a f7: if a, p, c, d > 0, pc >= a^2 and j >= d^2/(a+c), then Phi_c(O) >= 0 for all O in SO(4), for every q, e, b >= 0. This is a pointwise inequality and does not use realizability.

statements.label: Theorem 2
statements.restatement: d = 1, b > 1, 0 < a < 1/b, p > 0, q >= 0, j > 1, j <= e, j > eb/(e+b), j < 1 + 1/p, pc >= a^2. Every x in X with c(x) of this form has Phi_{c(x)} >= 0 on SO(4). Proof: Lemma 1 if j >= 1/(a+c); otherwise G > 0, which contradicts G = 0.
